title: Secure preload bridge
instructions:
Write a preload script that exposes a single function, getVersion(), to the renderer using contextBridge. The renderer must not get access to ipcRenderer or Node APIs.

Submit your preload file and a short README explaining how you validated the IPC sender in the main process. Save a checkpoint when the first version works.

tests.name: No raw ipcRenderer
tests.description: ipcRenderer is not exposed to the renderer.
